title: How often should I service my AC in Al Twar?
desc: Most residential AC systems benefit from professional servicing every 3 to 6 months. Systems that run heavily may need more frequent checks.

title: Why is my AC not cooling the room properly?
desc: The problem may be caused by dirty filters, low refrigerant, blocked coils, poor airflow, thermostat faults or compressor problems. An inspection can identify the cause.

title: Do you provide AC Repair Near Me in Al Twar?

title: Can you repair Split AC and Central AC systems?

title: What causes AC water leakage?
desc:
Common causes include:
  • Blocked drain line
  • Frozen evaporator coil
  • Dirty air filter
Continued leakage should be checked to avoid damage to walls, ceilings or flooring.

title: What is checked during AC maintenance?
desc: Maintenance may include filter cleaning, coil inspection, drain line cleaning, thermostat testing, airflow checks and cooling performance testing.

title: Do you provide AC Gas Refill?
desc: Yes, when low refrigerant is confirmed during inspection. The technician should check for a refrigerant leak before adding gas.

title: Why does my AC smell bad?
desc: A musty or unpleasant smell can develop from moisture, mould, bacteria or dust inside the AC. Professional cleaning can remove the buildup causing the smell.

title: Why does my AC make a loud noise?
desc: Noise can come from a loose component, fan motor, vibration, dirt buildup or worn parts. The source should be inspected before continued use causes more damage.

title: Can AC cleaning help lower electricity bills?
desc: Cleaning filters and coils can improve airflow and cooling efficiency. When an AC does not have to work as hard, electricity consumption may be reduced.

title: How long does an AC repair normally take?
desc: Many straightforward repairs can take around one to three hours, but the actual time depends on the fault, AC type and whether replacement parts are required.

title: Is an Annual Maintenance Contract useful?
desc: An AMC can be useful for frequently used systems because scheduled servicing helps identify problems early and keeps preventive maintenance on track.

title: Which AC brands do you service?
